blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Cloudy skies with rains may continue to affect parts of the country on Sunday, Nov. 8, due to the persistence of three weather systems, the state weather bureau reported. In its 4 p.m. weather forecast, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) reported that the easterlies may continue bring cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms over Eastern Visayas, Central Visayas, Caraga, Northern Mindanao, Zamboanga Peninsula, and Davao Oriental. Likewise, Metro Manila and the rest of the country are expected to experience partly cloudy to cloudy skies with isolated rains due to the easterlies. Pagasa warned […]...
